scope_rules: Only exact repository-relative paths listed in entries are classified; no directory, wildcard or neighboring-file ownership is implied.
PROPOSED records a reviewed recommendation awaiting user approval. UNRESOLVED records an ownership or inclusion decision still required. Neither status authorizes implementation or integration.
The authority_scope of an entry limits its proposed_owner, especially for mixed files and shared extension points.
Every exact path appears in only one entry. APPROVED applies only to that entry's explicit authority_scope and selected changes; excluded responsibilities remain unapproved even within the same file.
PARTIALLY_APPROVED is a root summary: only approval.approved_entries and their exact scopes are approved. All remaining PROPOSED and UNRESOLVED entries retain their previous lack of authorization.
Unlisted relevant infrastructure has unresolved ownership; stop and resolve it before changing it.
A widget-owned runtime dependency remains widget-owned even when a shared facade or router imports it.
Dependency groups describe review boundaries, not complete installable bundles or a release assembly order.
Future approval must identify exact entries, authority scope and a verifiable manifest revision. Branch names alone are not authority pins.
Implementation, review, integration, commits and deployment require separate authorization. This manifest authorizes no cross-worktree action.
Never replace approved shared files in TESTS with stale widget-branch copies. Require explicit integration approval and exact approved source/artifact identities.
Ownership approval does not prove compatibility. Tests cover their exercised cases and cannot guarantee compatibility with every widget.
